meta.name: depmap
meta.description: Query the Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) for cancer cell line gene dependency scores (CRISPR Chronos), drug sensitivity data, and gene effect profiles. Use for identifying cancer-specific vulnerabilities, synthetic lethal interactions, and validating oncology drug targets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询癌症依赖图谱数据，发现肿瘤靶点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在癌症研究中使用DepMap数据筛选基因依赖或药物敏感性。
copy.tagline_en: Query cancer dependency map data to discover tumor targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze cancer gene dependencies or drug sensitivity data from DepMap.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能查询 DepMap 癌细胞系的 CRISPR 基因依赖分数、药物敏感性和基因效应数据,帮你找癌症特异性依赖基因、合成致死关系和验证肿瘤药靶点。
howto.when: 当你问某个基因在特定癌种或突变细胞系里是否必需、寻找合成致死伙伴,或查询化合物敏感性时,它会接管。

say.text: KRAS 在肺癌细胞系里是选择性依赖还是泛必需基因?
say.note: 返回 Chronos 依赖分数和细胞系信息

say.text: 找出 BRCA1 突变细胞系中的合成致死伙伴基因
say.note: 比较突变型与野生型的基因效应

say.text: 哪些基因突变能预测某化合物在 PRISM 中的敏感性?
say.note: 关联化合物敏感性与基因组特征

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can query DepMap for CRISPR Chronos gene dependency scores, drug sensitivity and gene effect data in cancer cell lines, helping find cancer-selective dependencies and validate oncology drug targets.
howto.when_en: Use it when asking whether a gene is essential in a cancer type or mutant cell line, looking for synthetic lethal partners, or checking compound sensitivity.

say_en.text: Is KRAS a selective dependency or pan-essential in lung cancer cell lines?
say_en.note: Returns Chronos scores and cell line info

say_en.text: Find synthetic lethal partners in BRCA1-mutant cell lines
say_en.note: Compares gene effect in mutant vs WT lines

say_en.text: Which mutations predict compound sensitivity in PRISM data?
say_en.note: Correlates compound sensitivity with genomic features
